init_distributed_process_group: init a torch distributed process group using NCCL backend with env or SLURM rank detection
setup_distributed_printing: setup distributed printing to only output from the master process with timestamps
create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger to track smoothed training metrics and log them at intervals during iteration
track_smoothed_values: track smoothed values over a sliding window with median, average, and global average properties
sync_fid_across_processes: sync FrechetInceptionDistance metrics across all distributed processes and merge states into a final dict
